description: This file defines utility functions for resolving different types of 'lane' identifiers, such as session-specific, global, and embedded session lanes, based on input strings. It imports external 'CommandLane' constants from another module.

methods.name: export function resolveSessionLane(key: string) { resolveSessionLane
methods.description: Resolves a session lane identifier by ensuring it starts with 'session:', or defaults to 'session:CommandLane.Main' if input is empty or whitespace.

methods.name: export function resolveGlobalLane(lane?: string) { resolveGlobalLane
methods.description: Resolves a global lane identifier, returning 'Nested' if the input is the 'Cron' lane, otherwise returns the trimmed input or defaults to 'Main'.

methods.name: export function resolveEmbeddedSessionLane(key: string) { resolveEmbeddedSessionLane
methods.description: Alias function that resolves embedded session lanes by invoking 'resolveSessionLane'.
